inputs.question: 对比 KGP 与 CuriousLLM 在遍历开销控制上的发现：KGP 固定上下文预算时增大 branching factor 为何性能先升后降？CuriousLLM 引入提前终止变体（KGP_Mistral_ET）后，在四个 MD-QA 数据集上的表现相对完整版 KGP_Mistral 有何变化？

outputs.expected_answer: KGP 在固定总检索段落预算下，增大 branching factor 初期可提供更多候选路径提升效果，但过大会挤压初始种子节点数、降低 KG 覆盖率从而使效果下滑；CuriousLLM 的提前终止版 KGP_Mistral_ET 在四个 MD-QA 集上 Acc/EM 略低于完整版 KGP_Mistral，但在 HotpotQA/IIRC/MuSiQue 上仍高于 KGP_T5。

source_references.answer_point: KGP 在固定总检索段落预算下，增大 branching factor 初期会增加通往答案的推理路径使性能上升，但继续增大会挤占初始种子节点数量、降低对文档 KG 的覆盖率，导致性能下降。
source_references.title: Knowledge Graph Prompting for Multi-Document Question Answering

source_references.answer_point: CuriousLLM 在 Table 3 中显示提前终止变体 KGP_Mistral_ET 在四个 MD-QA 数据集上的 Acc/EM 略低于完整版 KGP_Mistral（如 HotpotQA Acc 72.20 vs 73.80、2WikiMQA 46.00 vs 49.40、IIRC 34.80 vs 36.69、MuSiQue 34.80 vs 36.50），但在 HotpotQA/IIRC/MuSiQue 上仍高于 KGP_T5。
source_references.title: CuriousLLM: Elevating Multi-Document QA with Reasoning-Infused Knowledge Graph Prompting

5.4
Sensitivity Analysis
Here we perform the sensitivity analysis of the branching
factor (the number of nodes selected from candidate neigh-
bors to visit next). In Figure 7(a)-(b), the performance first
increases as the branching factor increases because more
passage nodes selected from the candidate neighbors lead to
more reasoning paths to reach the final answer. However, as
we fix the context budget to ensure fair comparison (i.e., the
total number of passages we are allowed to retrieve for each
question is the same across all baselines), the performance
declines as the branching factor increases because the num-
ber of initial seeding nodes diminishes, leading to reduced
coverage of the KG. Furthermore, we compare the efficiency
of KGP when the constructed KG includes different num-
bers of documents in Figure 7(c). KGP consistently achieves
higher performance than other baselines and higher effi-
ciency than embedding-based DPR. TF-IDF is slightly faster
than KGP because it is a purely heuristic-based method.

Figure 7: (a)-(b): Performance first increases and then decreases as the branching factor increases. The results are averaged
across 100 sampled questions on 2WikiMQA and MuSiQue. (c): Performance/Efficiency increases/decreases as the number of
documents increases on MuSiQue. KGP-T5 achieves higher performance/efficiency than DPR.
5.3
Impact of Graph Traversal Agent
Here we study the influence of using different LLM agents to
traverse over TAGME-constructed KG on MD-QA. Specif-
ically, we compare agents that select the next neighbor to
visit randomly or intelligently via guidance from ChatGPT,
LLaMA, T5, and MDR in Table 2. Because the random
agent only blindly traverses the KG without any guidance
from LLM, it unavoidably collects irrelevant passages and
hence achieves the worst performance than others under
LLMs’ guidance. This aligns with our previous observation
on the low precision in Figure 5 and further demonstrates the
necessity of using LLMs to guide the graph traversal. Inter-
estingly, we find that KGP-T5 performs better than LLaMA
even though the parameters of LLaMA-7B are more than the
ones with T5-0.7B. We hypothesize this is because LLaMA-
7B requires more data to fine-tune than T5-0.7B.

relation_review.evidence: 核对全部必要事实、引用与原文；没有来源时不得补造。
relation_review.semantics: 核对方法归属、实体角色、实验设置与方向；未见题集须独立人工/代理语义判读。
relation_review.uncertainty: 反例题必须直接纠正错误前提或拒答越界实体，不得迎合题干伪前提。

scoring_rules.primary: SupportRecall@5; within one fact unit supporting sources are OR, required fact units are AND.
scoring_rules.answer_review: Per-case atomic reference criteria, scored 0/1 each by a named reviewer; evidence support and citation location checked separately.
scoring_rules.graph_coverage: Source-backed expected subgraphs are a reference check, not measured retrieval success or answer correctness.
scoring_rules.denominator: 32 answerable questions; 24 cross-paper relation questions reported separately; 8 negative cases reported separately.
scoring_rules.interpretation: retrieval coverage, citation validity, graph-path coverage and semantic answer correctness are separate results; no assumption that graph wins.
scoring_rules.semantic_score: Number of supported satisfied atomic criteria / all criteria. This is not calculated by source ID recall.
scoring_rules.semantic_pass: All criteria satisfied with supporting citations; no critical unsupported claim. Negatives must correct/reject the premise within the evidence boundary.
critical_errors: 伪造继承/评测/全称优越性
混淆预算耗尽与正确答案
scoring_rules.reporting: Overview, per-category metrics, charts, latency, tokens and full paired details must coexist after real execution.
